answer.reason: The verses tell of several deeds of Phinehas beyond his lineage and priesthood, chiefly the javelin deed at Peor, the covenant given him, and his mission to the eastern tribes.

clauses.english: killed an Israelite and a Midianite woman with a javelin, and the plague was stayed
was given the LORD's covenant of an everlasting priesthood
clauses.quote: the covenant of an everlasting priesthood

clauses.english: was sent to the eastern tribes over the altar they had built
clauses.quote: the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben
